description: This file defines multiple grain interface contracts for Orleans grains, each indicating capabilities related to activation, deactivation, and various test scenarios within a test namespace.

classes.name: ISimpleActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: Grain interface with methods for simple activation and deactivation tests, inheriting from IGrainWithIntegerKey, includes methods DoSomething and DoDeactivate.

classes.name: ITailCallActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: Grain interface for tail call activation/deactivation tests, inheriting from IGrainWithIntegerKey, includes methods DoSomething and DoDeactivate.

classes.name: ILongRunningActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for long-running activation/deactivation tests, inheriting from IGrainWithIntegerKey, includes methods DoSomething and DoDeactivate.

classes.name: IBadActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: Interface representing a grain with methods that throw exceptions or retrieve keys, inheriting from IGrainWithIntegerKey.

classes.name: IBadConstructorTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for testing constructor behavior, inheriting from IGrainWithIntegerKey, includes DoSomething method.

classes.name: ITaskActionActivateDeactivateTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for testing task-based activation/deactivation actions, inheriting from IGrainWithIntegerKey, includes DoSomething and DoDeactivate.

classes.name: ICreateGrainReferenceTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for creating grain references and forwarding calls, inheriting from IGrainWithIntegerKey.

classes.name: IDeactivatingWhileActivatingTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for testing deactivation during activation, inheriting from IGrainWithIntegerKey, includes method DoSomething.

methods.name: DoSomething
methods.description: Asynchronous method returning a string result, available in multiple grain interfaces for various tests.

methods.name: DoDeactivate
methods.description: Asynchronous method to deactivate the grain, present in several interfaces for activation/deactivation tests.

methods.name: ThrowSomething
methods.description: Method intended to throw an exception for testing error handling in grains.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Returns the key associated with the grain, as a long integer.

methods.name: ForwardCall
methods.description: Method to forward a call to another grain reference, facilitating testing of call forwarding.
